metadata.question: Did Washington D.C. experience an air temperature difference of at least 24 degrees Celcius between January 29 and February 5, 2019?

1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Dataset: ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY (global hourly 2 m air temperature), fallback to ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR if hourly returns empty.
- Dates: 2019-01-29 and 2019-02-05 (each as a 1-day window).
- Location: Washington, D.C. polygon from TIGER/2018/Counties (fallback: 15 km buffer around White House).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- No cloud masking needed (reanalysis data). Use full coverage.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection sizes; if 0 and fallback fails => C1.
- Check pixel counts after reduction; if 0 => C2.
- If mean is null/NaN => C3.
- Else compare absolute difference >= 24°C => A else B.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject);
  });
}

async function getDCGeometry() {
  try {
    const fc = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/Counties')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'District of Columbia'));
    const sz = await getInfoAsync(fc.size());
    if (sz && sz > 0) {
      return fc.geometry();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // fall through
  }
  // Fallback: 15 km buffer around the White House
  return ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0365, 38.8977]).buffer(15000);
}

async function dailyMeanC(dateStr, geom) {
  const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
  const end = start.advance(1, 'day');
  // Primary: ERA5-Land Hourly
  let used = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
  let col = ee.ImageCollection(used)
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .select('temperature_2m');
  let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
  if (!size || size === 0) {
    // Fallback: ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated
    used = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR';
    col = ee.ImageCollection(used)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select('temperature_2m');
    size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      return { ok: false, code: 'C1', msg: `No images for ${dateStr}.` };
    }
  }
  const img = col.mean(); // daily mean (or daily band if DAILY_AGGR)
  const countDict = img.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 9000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const cnt = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get('temperature_2m'));
  if (!cnt || cnt === 0) {
    return { ok: false, code: 'C2', msg: `No valid pixels for ${dateStr}.` };
  }
  const meanDict = img.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 9000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const meanK = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('temperature_2m'));
  if (meanK === null || meanK === undefined || isNaN(meanK)) {
    return { ok: false, code: 'C3', msg: `Invalid mean for ${dateStr}.` };
  }
  const meanC = meanK - 273.15;
  return { ok: true, used, size, cnt, meanC };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = await getDCGeometry();
    const day1 = '2019-01-29';
    const day2 = '2019-02-05';
    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const s1 = await dailyMeanC(day1, geom);
    if (!s1.ok) {
      console.log(`Date ${day1}: ${s1.msg}`);
      console.log(s1.code);
      return;
    }
    const s2 = await dailyMeanC(day2, geom);
    if (!s2.ok) {
      console.log(`Date ${day2}: ${s2.msg}`);
      console.log(s2.code);
      return;
    }
    // 3. Processing & Evidence
    console.log(`Location: Washington, D.C. (geom area km2 ≈ ${Math.round((await getInfoAsync(geom.area(1))).valueOf()/1e6)})`);
    console.log(`${day1} Source: ${s1.used}, Images: ${s1.size}, Pixels: ${s1.cnt}, Mean T2m (°C): ${s1.meanC.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`${day2} Source: ${s2.used}, Images: ${s2.size}, Pixels: ${s2.cnt}, Mean T2m (°C): ${s2.meanC.toFixed(2)}`);
    const diff = Math.abs(s2.meanC - s1.meanC);
    console.log(`Absolute difference (°C): ${diff.toFixed(2)}`);
    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if (!isFinite(diff)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const answer = diff >= 24 ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
